platforms.name: Self-hosted web/PWA
platforms.signing: Sigstore/cosign or minisign detached signature on the release bundle; HTTPS/TLS at the owner's domain

inRelease: Aetherius Foundation packages: app-kit, desktop, crossplatform, store domain cores
Files, Notes, Calendar, Photos domain cores with durable local persistence
Writer, Sheets, Slides, Preview document domain cores with documented format subset
Athena local-first assistant with default-deny tools and audit chain
Sovereign Finance: internal ledger and paper accounting only
Multi-Cross-Platform Trading Bot: paper trading and backtesting only
Compute kernel: native binary path; balanced-ternary and quantum state-vector simulation
Self-hosted cloud stack template (14 services) with documented licence obligations
CycloneDX SBOM and generated third-party notices
Hybrid multi-licence map: Apache-2.0 foundations, AGPL-3.0-or-later default, dual AGPL/commercial finance and trading cores
outOfRelease: Live banking, card issuing, brokerage, exchange, custody, KYC/AML, market-data, DeFi, staking, lending, and other live financial adapters
Ternary hardware execution and FPGA synthesis claims
Quantum hardware execution and remote QPU claims
A bootable general-purpose Aetherius OS kernel
Linux Flatpak and DEB artifacts until signed and install-tested
macOS notarisation, iOS distribution, Microsoft Store, and Google Play until developer accounts and signing identities exist
Professional Studio, Engineering, Built Environment, Science, IDE, and Business workspaces beyond domain scaffolds
Full DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF fidelity, real-time collaboration, media codecs, CAD, BIM, and MIDI acceptance
Any claim of 5-star parity with commercial professional suites

futureStages.gate: Signed Flatpak/DEB artifacts plus install, launch, and rollback evidence
Paid signing identities, independent audits, device matrix, performance evidence, full acceptance fixtures, and a measured 5-star benchmark

requiredEvidenceBeforeRelease: SECURITY.md with a monitored disclosure contact
Lawyer-reviewed privacy policy with a review marker
Signed artifacts for every declared platform, with detached signatures
Independent security and WCAG 2.2 AA audits with named auditors
Install/launch/rollback evidence on every declared platform
Measured p95 performance evidence on named hardware
Full acceptance fixtures for every format claimed in the release notes
5-star benchmark only for dimensions actually measured; otherwise disclose the gap
notes: The scope is approved for 0.1.0 as a free-first, self-hosted web/PWA developer preview. The broader 1.0 platform matrix remains PLANNED and must not be claimed until its signing, audit, device, and performance evidence exists. The release gate remains fail-closed.
